description: The structured workout an activity was started from, step by step: warm-up / active / rest, how each step ends (time, distance in m, reps, heart rate or lap button), its target (HR zone or bpm / % of max HR range, pace range, power, cadence) and repeat groups (`back_to_step`, `times`). Compare with garmin_get_activity for planned vs. actual. Empty for activities not started from a workout created in Garmin Connect. Get the activity id from garmin_search_activities.
name: garmin_get_activity_workouts
title: Get Garmin activity workout
